findings.title: CSI driver is not running
findings.cause: a volume of the pod uses CSI driver csi.kd-faults.example.com, which is not registered on node kd-faults-control-plane, so the volume cannot be mounted; Deployment db has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: MountVolume.MountDevice failed for volume "kd-csi-driver-missing" : kubernetes.io/csi: attacher.MountDevice failed to create newCsiDriverClient: driver name csi.kd-faults.example.com not found in the list of registered CSI drivers

evidence.what: the CSI drivers registered on node kd-faults-control-plane

findings.fix: Install the csi.kd-faults.example.com CSI driver, or check that its node DaemonSet runs on node kd-faults-control-plane and its controller is up (their pods are usually in kube-system or the driver's namespace).
